rules: Append new evidence; do not erase earlier acceptance or rejection.
Contextual release labels are not readbacks of installed versions.
Unknown results remain AWAITING_TEST; no artificial pass/fail.
Screenshot evidence is scoped to what is visible, not the entire procedure.
